description: ZP-MC03A-1-FS004 is the drawing identifier for connector insert in AutomationDirect's ZIPport Multi-Wire Connectors collection. A connector insert carries the selected connection interface within its compatible housing. The insert drawing does not describe the complete housing, hood or cable restraint.

For example, in a detachable machine field-wiring assembly, use the ZP-MC03A-1-FS004 reference to coordinate insert mounting, conductor approach and mating interface. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.
